execution: private Kaggle CPU-only notebook; accelerator disabled; sequential models
candidate_safeguard: only tokenizer EOS, ordinarily scored; never observed gold

branch_diagnostics.normalized_branch_entropy: entropy(marginal branch mass)/log(M), zero for M=1
branch_diagnostics.useful_unique_probability_mass: sum full-model probabilities on branch-unique retrieved IDs; excludes common EOS safeguard
branch_diagnostics.omission: omit one retrieval query; reallocate total budget by quotient/remainder across ascending active branch IDs; retain original full-M scoring law
branch_diagnostics.omission_delta: omitted-branch retrieval metric minus all-branch retrieval metric; can be positive after reallocation
branch_diagnostics.single_query_omission: not applicable: no active retrieval branches remain

timing.order: exact/hnsw for even prompt cell; hnsw/exact for odd cell
timing.continuation: same own-exact forced continuation within checkpoint; distinct from own-feedback generation
timing.head_share: head_seconds / wall_seconds from one separately instrumented forced cached decode, including clock/loop overhead; never a parameter fraction

real_generation.selection: greedy with own-token feedback and scored EOS stopping

cold_index_request.scope: model-resident warm process; fresh HNSW build, full fingerprint validation and own-feedback request measured inclusively

resource_scope: RSS snapshots and 20-ms sampled construction peaks are actual process observations; sequential allocator retention and lifetime HWM prevent isolated per-model memory interpretation
quality_scope: seed0 feasibility only; existing exact learning NLL remains visible; no training-quality promotion, synthetic vocabularies, width edits, translation or NLI
